description: Election Commission - Declare that F. M. Sifan as a Member of the Kalmunai Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a municipal council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a resigned council member, including the nomination procedure by a recognized political party and the formal declaration of the new member by the returning officer. This falls squarely under election-related matters, specifically covering candidate nominations and declarations for local government elections.
